title: Color / Secondary colors and usage proportions
slide_intent: Preserve differences between routine color and meaningful accents so viewers can recognize moments that deserve attention.
strategic_value: A white-and-black foundation with restrained transport-derived colors can preserve consistency while allowing Uber illustrations and product to carry variety.
demonstration: Six labeled secondary swatches sit above a diagram grouping primary colors, Safety Blue and secondary colors. Adjacent copy explains restraint and relative usage.
practical_value: Keep primary colors dominant, reserve Safety Blue for care moments and check the stated context before using secondary colors.

content_islands.name: Secondary palette
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation at upper left beside six vertical swatches: green, yellow, red, brown, orange and purple, each with printed values.

content_islands.name: Usage proportions
content_islands.spec: Place the usage text at lower left opposite the stacked color diagram: white/black above blue, then two rows of secondary colors.

ingredient.name: Secondary colors and color proportions
ingredient.role: Support variety while keeping the primary palette and care signal distinguishable.
ingredient.application: Use secondary colors sparingly; balance white with black; reserve Safety Blue for critical moments of care. Do not derive a percentage from this unnumbered diagram.
ingredient.scope: Historical partner guide. Secondary-color copy first mentions illustration, photography and product, then narrows use to illustrations and product; retain that ambiguity rather than expanding the permission.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links restraint to meaning and potency and proportions to consistency and accessibility.
reference_purposes.Expression: The palette and stacked diagram distinguish neutral, safety and secondary color groups.
reference_purposes.Application: The page supplies secondary swatches and a qualitative usage diagram without numerical percentages.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page reserves Safety Blue for critical care moments and says secondary colors are only used for illustrations and within product; an earlier sentence also mentions photography.
